title: DMC3 HD PC Save Record Envelope and Checksum ABI — Wide Pass 32

records.title: Exact 21-record envelope layout
records.summary: The 0x4A30 save consists exactly of one 0x134+4 global record, ten 0x3C+4 summary records and ten 0x708+4 payload records. Payload records begin at 0x3B8 and use stride 0x70C; the previously proposed standalone 0x28 pre-payload block is rejected.

locations.note: All 21 physical record boundaries and file-end identity validated.
VA 0x14032A4B0 provides count 10 and internal sizes 0x134, 0x3C and 0x708.

records.title: Generic recordState/checksum trailer and checksum generator
records.summary: Every serialized record ends with {u16 recordState, u16 checksum}. The generator at VA 0x14033EED0 computes a 16-bit one's-complement checksum with end-around carry; a complete valid record folds to 0xFFFF. All 21 records in the canonical save validate and the stored checksum equals the independently calculated checksum.

locations.note: VA 0x14033EED0; called for global, summary and payload records.
Pass 32 CSV/JSON independently validates 21/21 records. All promoted record lengths are even.

records.title: Observed recordState behavior
records.summary: The canonical sample uses recordState 1 for the global record, occupied summaries and every payload record, while empty summaries use 0. A payload record therefore exists even when the corresponding summary is empty. Values beyond 0/1 remain research required and must not be rejected by product code solely for being unobserved.

locations.note: Observed summary recordState distribution contains both 0 and 1.
All ten observed payload recordState values are 1.

records.title: Partial global-record structural map
records.summary: The global 0x134 body has a confirmed compatibilityTag 0xDEC0 at +0x108, a writer-cleared region +0x046..+0x106, a runtime flag at +0x107, separate legacy fallback bytes at +0x10A/+0x10B and a reserved tail +0x10C..+0x133. Other fields retain neutral names pending semantic ownership recovery.

locations.note: File observation corroborates offsets and zero/reserved regions.

records.title: Payload active and reserved-region boundary
records.summary: Within each 0x708 payload body, +0x000..+0x6EB is active serialized data, +0x6EC..+0x705 is explicitly cleared by the observed writer, and +0x706..+0x707 is zero in the sample but writer ownership remains unresolved. This is a structural boundary only, not semantic editing authority.

records.title: Pass 33 semantic frontier remains gated
records.summary: Runtime ownership for global fields, global +0x1C..+0x45, semantic segmentation of payload +0x000..+0x6EB, summary +0x0C/+0x10/+0x14, recordState values beyond 0/1 and exact writer lifecycle remain unresolved. Product code may expose neutral structural observations but must not provide semantic mutation APIs before controlled differential-save evidence and runtime traces.

locations.note: Canonical next target requires semantic recovery through at least two save versions and runtime ownership mapping.
